description: Read Markdown for a page in the selected locale, including original parameters, codes and warnings. Follow next_offset until null for the complete page; offsets and max_chars count Unicode code points. No filesystem or external URL access.

locale.description: Documentation language: English en, español es, 中文 zh. Required; no cross-language fallback.

page.description: Stable page ID from search/list, e.g. api/balance, rental/default-services, email/providers, sdks or index. A matching relative /en/docs/.../ URL also works.

name: smspva_docs_read_page
title: Read a documentation page
